Hello, my friend! I am Ananse. Today we are going to sort things into groups.
Look. I have six things. Some are red, and some are blue.
The red ones go on this mat. The blue ones go on that mat.
Three red things, and three blue things. We sorted them by colour.
Now watch. I will mix them up, and sort the same six things a different way.
The circles go on this mat. The triangles go on that mat.
Three circles, and three triangles. We sorted them by shape.
Look! The groups are not the same, but nothing about the things changed.
This one is a red circle.
It can sit with the red things.
Or it can sit with the circles.
It is still the same red circle. Both ways are right.
Today we sorted six things by colour, and then by shape.
At home, you can sort your things too. Try your socks, or your toys.
